name: Hero Catalog
description: Complete definitions for every recruitable and promotable hero class.

Guardian.name: Guardian
Guardian.description: A heavily protected frontline hero who controls enemy attention and intercepts attacks aimed at vulnerable allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Shields the most injured ally, then draws attacks toward the Guardian while hardening their defenses for a short time. The shield lasts until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always generates extra threat and gains more physical defense while allies remain standing.

Knight.name: Knight
Knight.description: An armored defender who blocks routes, challenges dangerous enemies, and protects adjacent allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes the strongest enemy and weakens the entire enemy formation, with the primary target suffering the greater penalty. The Knight then draws enemy attention and intercepts attacks for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always generates extra threat, gains more physical defense while allies remain standing, and resists harmful effects more often.

Royal Bastion.name: Royal Bastion
Royal Bastion.description: An immovable champion whose presence shields the entire formation and denies enemies control of the frontline.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the entire party a barrier that lasts until broken, while raising physical and magical defenses for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies gain physical and magical defense while the Royal Bastion remains standing.

Paladin.name: Paladin
Paladin.description: A sacred protector who combines defensive techniques with healing, cleansing, and protection from hostile magic.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the most injured ally, cleanses all harmful effects, and raises their magical defense for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Healing is stronger and magical defense is always increased. Skill-based heals grant a barrier. After every action, Merciful Surge heals a random wounded ally.

Dawn Warden.name: Dawn Warden
Dawn Warden.description: A radiant guardian who turns divine protection into powerful counterattacks and party-wide barriers.

stats.skill_act_desc: Grants the entire party barriers that last until broken, then improves their chance to counter and the strength of their counters for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies receive stronger healing and resist harmful effects more often. Whenever an ally takes damage, the Dawn Warden's counter chance briefly improves.

Fighter.name: Fighter
Fighter.description: A dependable melee combatant who builds momentum through sustained attacks and adapts to different weapons.

stats.skill_act_desc: Delivers a powerful weapon strike and increases the Fighter's damage for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Each basic attack steadily increases the Fighter's damage, building momentum throughout the battle.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description: An aggressive warrior who trades defense and health for escalating damage, speed, and resistance to control.

stats.skill_act_desc: Sacrifices some health to unleash a flurry of strikes, then greatly increases damage for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Damage steadily rises as health falls, reaching its greatest strength when the Berserker is near defeat.

Blood Champion.name: Blood Champion
Blood Champion.description: A relentless destroyer who becomes most dangerous when wounded and can overwhelm entire enemy groups.

stats.skill_act_desc: Sweeps through every enemy and immediately drains health from each target struck.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Defeating an enemy immediately restores health and briefly raises damage. The Blood Champion can also survive a lethal blow before this protection is spent.

Duelist.name: Duelist
Duelist.description: A precise combatant who parries attacks, exploits openings, and excels when fighting a single opponent.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes an enemy, then guarantees a powerful counter against incoming attacks for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Gains increased evasion and critical chance while remaining focused on the same enemy.

Swordmaster.name: Swordmaster
Swordmaster.description: A peerless weapon specialist who converts perfect timing and positioning into devastating finishing attacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Executes a guaranteed critical strike that cuts through much of the target's physical defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has increased critical and counter chances, and every critical hit immediately restores mana.

Rogue.name: Rogue
Rogue.description: A fast, elusive hero who uses stealth, flanking, and critical strikes to eliminate priority targets.

stats.skill_act_desc: Ambushes the strongest enemy with a high chance to critically strike while cutting through part of its physical defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Deals increased damage to wounded enemies, permanently improves evasion, and naturally draws less enemy attention.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.description: A burst-damage specialist who marks isolated targets and attacks from concealment for lethal results.

stats.skill_act_desc: Finishes the most wounded enemy with a strike that grows stronger as the target weakens, then leaves it vulnerable for several turns if it survives.
stats.skill_psv_desc: The opening attack against each new target gains greatly increased damage and critical chance.

Nightblade.name: Nightblade
Nightblade.description: A master killer who moves between shadows, chains executions, and disappears before enemies can retaliate.

stats.skill_act_desc: Dashes through every enemy, dealing extra damage to the wounded. Defeating a target greatly improves the Nightblade's evasion for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Defeating an enemy briefly raises both damage and evasion.

Trickster.name: Trickster
Trickster.description: A disruptive skirmisher who uses feints, smoke, theft, and misdirection to manipulate the battlefield.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes every enemy and weakens their attacks for several turns, while greatly increasing the Trickster's chance to evade for the same duration.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has increased evasion and critical chance. Every successful evade briefly raises damage.

Phantom.name: Phantom
Phantom.description: An untouchable saboteur who creates decoys, steals enemy advantages, and turns hostile plans against their owners.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes the strongest enemy, greatly improves the Phantom's evasion for a short time, and leaves the target vulnerable for the same duration.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has greatly increased evasion. Every successful evade restores mana immediately and briefly raises damage.

Ranger.name: Ranger
Ranger.description: A ranged hunter who scouts hostile territory, marks targets, and gains advantages from terrain and distance.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes the strongest enemy and leaves it vulnerable to all incoming damage for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has increased dexterity and deals extra damage to enemies that have not yet acted in the current wave.

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.description: A patient marksman who sacrifices mobility for exceptional range, armor penetration, and single-target damage.

stats.skill_act_desc: Fires a devastating shot at the strongest enemy with an increased chance to critically strike, cutting through much of its physical defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has increased critical chance, and the opening attack of each wave deals extra damage.

Deadeye.name: Deadeye
Deadeye.description: A legendary shooter who exposes hidden weaknesses and can decide a battle with one perfectly prepared shot.

stats.skill_act_desc: Fires a guaranteed critical shot at the most wounded enemy, cutting through much of its physical defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has increased critical chance. Critical hits leave the target vulnerable for several turns.

Beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
Beastmaster.description: A versatile hunter who fights alongside an animal companion and coordinates attacks with it.

stats.skill_act_desc: Commands the bonded beast to attack alongside the Beastmaster, then grants the Beastmaster a barrier that lasts until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always deals increased damage. When badly wounded, periodically gains a barrier that lasts until broken.

Wild Warden.name: Wild Warden
Wild Warden.description: A master of the hunt who commands a powerful bonded beast and turns the surrounding wilderness into an ally.

stats.skill_act_desc: Calls a spectral pack to strike every enemy repeatedly, then increases the Wild Warden's damage for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Every allied basic attack steadily increases the Wild Warden's damage, building momentum throughout the battle.

Cleric.name: Cleric
Cleric.description: A divine support hero who restores health, removes harmful conditions, and protects the party from supernatural threats.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the most injured ally and raises their magical defense for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Healing is always stronger. Skill-based heals cleanse harmful effects and restore mana. After every action, Twin Mercy delivers repeated healing pulses to a random wounded ally.

Priest.name: Priest
Priest.description: A dedicated healer who provides efficient restoration, blessings, and emergency protection for wounded allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Immediately heals the entire party and continues restoring their health for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Healing is always stronger, and excess skill healing becomes a barrier. After every action, Shared Grace spreads healing evenly across random wounded allies.

High Priest.name: High Priest
High Priest.description: A supreme spiritual healer whose miracles can rescue an entire party from defeat and restore fallen heroes.

stats.skill_act_desc: Returns a fallen ally to battle immediately. If no ally has fallen, delivers a powerful heal to the most injured ally instead.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies continuously regenerate health, and healing becomes stronger while the High Priest is badly wounded. After every action, Miracle's Wake heals a random wounded ally and becomes stronger when that ally is near defeat.

Inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
Inquisitor.description: A battle cleric who exposes corruption, dispels enemy magic, and punishes cursed or supernatural foes.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes the strongest enemy with magic, removes its beneficial effects, and leaves it vulnerable to all damage for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always deals increased magical damage and deals additional damage to any enemy suffering a harmful effect.

Demon Hunter.name: Demon Hunter
Demon Hunter.description: A relentless purifier who seals hostile powers and specializes in destroying summoned, undead, and corrupted enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes the strongest enemy, dealing extra damage to supernatural foes and silencing its active skill for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always resists harmful effects more often. Successfully resisting a harmful effect briefly raises damage.

Mage.name: Mage
Mage.description: A fragile spellcaster who spends mana to deal area damage, alter the battlefield, and control groups of enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Releases unstable magic across the enemy party, with an additional burst against the primary target.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Deals increased damage while the Mage's mana remains high.

Elementalist.name: Elementalist
Elementalist.description: An offensive caster who combines fire, frost, lightning, and earth to exploit weaknesses and create reactions.

stats.skill_act_desc: Blasts every enemy with elemental magic, dealing ongoing damage and randomly reducing attack, reducing evasion, or inflicting vulnerability for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always deals increased damage, and every active skill cast immediately restores some mana.

Archon.name: Archon
Archon.description: A living conduit of elemental power who reshapes large areas and chains multiple elements into catastrophic spells.

stats.skill_act_desc: Engulfs every enemy in elemental magic, leaves them vulnerable for several turns, and immediately restores mana to the party.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always deals increased magical damage, and every tick of ongoing damage immediately restores some mana.

Arcanist.name: Arcanist
Arcanist.description: A technical mage who manipulates raw magic through barriers, teleportation, interruption, and spell amplification.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes the strongest enemy, silences its active skill for a short time, and immediately refunds some of the Arcanist's mana.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Deals increased damage to enemies whose active skills are silenced.

Grand Magus.name: Grand Magus
Grand Magus.description: A master of pure sorcery who rewrites the rules of combat by altering range, cost, timing, and magical effects.

stats.skill_act_desc: Restores party mana and raises allied damage and evasion for several turns, while weakening every enemy's attacks for the same duration.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Every active skill cast steadily increases the Grand Magus's damage, building power throughout the battle.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.description: A charismatic support hero who maintains performances that strengthen allies, weaken enemies, and shape party morale.

stats.skill_act_desc: Immediately heals the entire party and raises allied damage for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies deal increased damage, and active skills build the Bard's damage. After every action, Restorative Refrain shares healing between random wounded allies.

Minstrel.name: Minstrel
Minstrel.description: An inspiring performer who sustains healing melodies, resource recovery, and long-lasting party enhancements.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the entire party, restores mana immediately, and continues restoring health for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Healing and regeneration are stronger, and skill-based heals restore mana. After every action, Threefold Ballad shares healing evenly between random wounded allies in repeated pulses.

Virtuoso.name: Virtuoso
Virtuoso.description: A brilliant artist who layers several performances at once and transforms party coordination into overwhelming tempo.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the party and restores mana immediately, then raises allied damage and both defenses for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies deal increased damage and receive stronger healing. After every action, Grand Healing Chorus spreads healing across random wounded allies.

Skald.name: Skald
Skald.description: A martial storyteller whose battle chants improve offense, courage, and resistance while pressuring nearby enemies.

stats.skill_act_desc: Raises the entire party's damage, critical chance, and resistance to harmful effects for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies always gain increased critical chance, and every allied critical hit immediately restores some of the Skald's mana.

War Chanter.name: War Chanter
War Chanter.description: A commanding voice on the battlefield who drives allies into heroic action and breaks the resolve of enemy formations.

stats.skill_act_desc: Raises the entire party's damage and critical chance for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies always deal increased damage. Whenever an ally defeats an enemy, the War Chanter's damage rises for the rest of the battle.

Engineer.name: Engineer
Engineer.description: A tactical specialist who deploys devices, traps, and consumable inventions to prepare and control the battlefield.

stats.skill_act_desc: Deploys an adaptive device that strikes an enemy, weakens its attacks for several turns, and grants every ally a barrier that lasts until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always gains increased damage and physical defense, and starts every wave with a barrier that lasts until broken.

Artificer.name: Artificer
Artificer.description: A magical inventor who equips allies with enchanted devices, protective constructs, and adaptable utility tools.

stats.skill_act_desc: Enhances the strongest ally, raising their damage, critical chance, and magical defense for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies always gain increased damage and magical defense while the Artificer remains standing.

Master Artificer.name: Master Artificer
Master Artificer.description: A visionary creator whose autonomous constructs and legendary equipment can redefine the party's capabilities.

stats.skill_act_desc: Deploys a construct that strikes every enemy, grants the party barriers that last until broken, and restores allied health over an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies gain damage and physical defense while the Master Artificer regenerates health. After every action, Repair Sequence shares healing between random wounded allies in repeated pulses.

Machinist.name: Machinist
Machinist.description: A battlefield operator who deploys turrets, explosives, and mechanical weapons to control key positions.

stats.skill_act_desc: Builds a turret that rapidly fires repeated shots at the most wounded enemy, with each shot cutting through part of its physical defense.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Every basic attack steadily increases damage throughout the battle, and all attacks cut through part of the target's physical defense.

Siege Architect.name: Siege Architect
Siege Architect.description: A master of heavy machinery who constructs fortified positions and brings overwhelming mechanical firepower.

stats.skill_act_desc: Bombards every enemy, grants the party barriers that last until broken, and raises the Siege Architect's physical defense for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always gains increased physical defense, and every basic attack steadily increases damage throughout the battle.

Monk.name: Monk
Monk.description: A disciplined combatant who generates focus through movement, counters, and attack combinations before spending it on advanced techniques.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes an enemy, immediately restores mana to the party, and improves the Monk's chance to counter for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has increased counter chance, and every basic attack steadily increases damage throughout the battle.

Martial Artist.name: Martial Artist
Martial Artist.description: A mobile melee specialist who changes stances, completes combos, and counters predictable enemy attacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes the strongest enemy while cutting through part of its physical defense, then improves the Martial Artist's evasion for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has increased evasion and counter chance. Every active skill cast steadily increases damage throughout the battle.

Grandmaster.name: Grandmaster
Grandmaster.description: A flawless combatant who flows freely between stances and turns enemy aggression into decisive counterattacks.

stats.skill_act_desc: Enters perfect readiness, greatly improving evasion and guaranteeing devastating counters for a short time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always has greatly increased counter chance and counter damage, and counters cannot be evaded.

Mystic.name: Mystic
Mystic.description: A spiritual support fighter who channels focus into barriers, cleansing techniques, and restorative energy.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the most injured ally, cleanses all harmful effects, grants a barrier until broken, and raises magical defense for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Healing is stronger, all allies gain magical defense, and gaining mana heals the most injured ally. After every action, Spirit Balance shares healing between random wounded allies, favoring those closest to defeat.

Enlightened One.name: Enlightened One
Enlightened One.description: A transcendent guardian who shares focus with allies and protects the party through perfect spiritual balance.

stats.skill_act_desc: Redistributes the party's health evenly, grants everyone barriers until broken, and improves resistance to harmful effects for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies resist harmful effects, and excess mana heals the party. After every action, Balanced Restoration spreads healing among random wounded allies, favoring those closest to defeat.

Druid.name: Druid
Druid.description: A nature-bound hero who builds harmony by cycling abilities and uses it to transform creatures, terrain, and weather.

stats.skill_act_desc: When allies are wounded, heals the party and continues restoring health for a short time. Otherwise, damages every enemy and inflicts ongoing decay for the same duration.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Healing and damage are increased, and active skills build damage. After every action, Renewing Seed heals a random wounded ally immediately and continues restoring their health over time.

Shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
Shapeshifter.description: An adaptable combatant who assumes animal forms suited to defense, mobility, or close-range damage.

stats.skill_act_desc: Assumes a predatory form that greatly raises damage and evasion while also improving physical defense for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always gains increased physical and magical defense. Every active skill cast steadily raises damage throughout the battle.

Primal Avatar.name: Primal Avatar
Primal Avatar.description: An embodiment of the wild who combines traits from multiple beasts and transforms without sacrificing momentum.

stats.skill_act_desc: Mauls every enemy, gains a barrier that lasts until broken, and raises damage and physical defense for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always gains increased damage and physical defense, and deals even more damage while badly wounded.

Grove Keeper.name: Grove Keeper
Grove Keeper.description: A nature caster who grows healing plants, restrains enemies with roots, and creates favorable terrain.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals the entire party and continues restoring allied health for an extended time, while weakening every enemy's attacks for the same duration.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Healing and regeneration are stronger, with extra physical defense at full health. After every action, Verdant Regrowth shares healing evenly between random wounded allies, restoring health both immediately and over time.

Archdruid.name: Archdruid
Archdruid.description: A supreme keeper of nature who commands forests and storms, causing the battlefield itself to aid the party.

stats.skill_act_desc: Calls a storm that damages every enemy, heals the party, and leaves both ongoing decay and restorative rain on the battlefield for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: All allies regenerate health and receive stronger healing, while ongoing damage is increased. After every action, Restorative Rain spreads healing evenly among random wounded allies, restoring health both immediately and over time.

Warlock.name: Warlock
Warlock.description: A forbidden caster who accumulates corruption to fuel unusually powerful curses and summons at personal risk.

stats.skill_act_desc: Sacrifices some health to blast the strongest enemy, inflicting ongoing corruption while increasing the Warlock's damage for several turns.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always gains increased damage and life steal while continuously accumulating personal corruption.

Hexbinder.name: Hexbinder
Hexbinder.description: A curse specialist who weakens enemies and places delayed hexes that trigger when specific conditions are met.

stats.skill_act_desc: Strikes the strongest enemy, then afflicts it with a damaging hex and leaves it vulnerable for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Ongoing damage is stronger, and all attacks deal additional damage to enemies suffering any harmful effect.

Doomcaller.name: Doomcaller
Doomcaller.description: A master of inevitable ruin whose curses spread between enemies and convert their failures into further calamities.

stats.skill_act_desc: Curses every enemy with ongoing damage and vulnerability for an extended time.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Ongoing damage is greatly stronger, and defeating an enemy immediately restores mana.

Demonologist.name: Demonologist
Demonologist.description: A dangerous summoner who sacrifices health or control to bind powerful infernal creatures.

stats.skill_act_desc: Sacrifices some health to unleash repeated demonic strikes against an enemy, then gains a barrier that lasts until broken.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always gains increased damage and gains a barrier until broken after every active skill cast, while continuously accumulating personal corruption.

Infernal Lord.name: Infernal Lord
Infernal Lord.description: A supreme binder who commands several demons, transfers corruption to them, and unleashes their full forbidden power.

stats.skill_act_desc: Sacrifices some health to unleash repeated demonic strikes against every enemy, draining health throughout the assault.
stats.skill_psv_desc: Always gains greatly increased damage and life steal. Defeating an enemy immediately restores additional health.
